name: kyrgyz-bench-data-mrpc
description:
Kyrgyz MRPC Paraphrase Detection Dataset
	


	
		
		Task
	

Paraphrase Detection (Sentence Pair Classification)

	
		
		Description
	

Microsoft Research Paraphrase Corpus (MRPC) translated from English to Kyrgyz. Each entry contains two sentence pairs with Kyrgyz translations and a binary label indicating whether the sentences are paraphrases.

Labels: paraphrase, not_paraphrase
Format: JSONL with fields: sentence1, sentence2, label, sentence1_ky, sentence2_ky


	
		
	
	
		Dataset… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/metinovadilet/kyrgyz-bench-data-mrpc.
reputation: A small, language-specific MRPC translation for Kyrgyz that is useful for low-resource multilingual NLP research but has limited community adoption so far.
